newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Investment performance boosts AMP NZ's 1996 result.
newsitem.headline: Investment performance boosts AMP NZ's 1996 result.

text.p: AMP New Zealand, part of giant regional institution Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP), said on Wednesday its local New Zealand unit's total consolidated income last year rose by NZ$7 million to $872 million on the back of strong investment income growth.

Detailing figures released earlier this month, it said its AMP Investment arm's consolidated income rose $17 million to $550 million, while life premium income from New Zealand was $331 million, up $10 million on 1996.

The unit's general manager Rodney Cook said in a statement that "AMP Investments enjoyed a strong performance above the benchmark index in most asset classes, while a restructured agency force used its competitive advantages to outmanoeuvre other financial suppliers".
"AMP Investments remains New Zealand's largest funds manager, with a total of NZ$6.4 billion under management," Cook added.
